description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git pack corruption resilience. It includes functions to create test files, simulate pack creation and corruption, and various test cases verifying recovery mechanisms after data corruption.

methods.name: create_test_files
methods.description: Creates sample files with random data and specific labels to set up test objects for Git pack testing.

methods.name: create_new_pack
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository, creates objects from test files, packs them, and verifies the pack integrity.

methods.name: do_repack
methods.description: Recreates the object pack, possibly corrupts pack files to simulate data corruption, and verifies recovery.

methods.name: do_corrupt_object
methods.description: Introduces corruption into specific objects within the pack file at specified offsets.
